## Setup

```{r load}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(INLA)
  library(sf)
  library(spdep)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(viridis)
  library(scales)
  library(knitr)
})

Sys.unsetenv("MallocStackLogging")
# Threading and solver selection affect runtime only.
# CV_NUM_THREADS overrides INLA thread config; FIT_USE_PARDISO=1 enables Pardiso.
.cv_nthr <- Sys.getenv("CV_NUM_THREADS", "1:4")
inla.setOption(num.threads = .cv_nthr)
inla.setOption(inla.mode = "compact")
.pardiso_env <- tolower(Sys.getenv("FIT_USE_PARDISO", ""))
if (!.pardiso_env %in% c("", "0", "false", "no", "off")) {
  inla.setOption(smtp = "pardiso")
  .pchk <- tryCatch(capture.output(INLA::inla.pardiso.check()),
                    error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  message("[10b] PARDISO enabled | num.threads=", .cv_nthr,
          " | inla.pardiso.check: ", paste(.pchk, collapse = " "))
} else {
  inla.setOption(smtp = "taucs")
  message("[10b] PARDISO disabled (FIT_USE_PARDISO='", .pardiso_env,
          "') | smtp=taucs | num.threads=", .cv_nthr)
}

# Outlier quantile for holdout scoring only.
options(cv_outlier_q = 0.999)

# Posterior draws for out-of-fold mobility attribution.
options(cv_posterior_draws = 200L)

source(here::here("helpers/_adjacency.R"))
source(here::here("helpers/_cv_helpers.R"))
load_pipeline()

# Timestamped progress log.
log_msg <- function(...) {
  msg <- paste0(sprintf("[%s] ", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S")),
                paste0(c(...), collapse = ""))
  cat(msg, "\n", sep = "")
  flush.console()
  side <- Sys.getenv("CV_SIDE_LOG", "")
  if (nzchar(side)) cat(msg, "\n", file = side, append = TRUE, sep = "")
}
```

## Spatial CV Function

```{r spatial_cv_fn}
run_area_spatial_cv <- function(md, folds_dt, wave_label, warmstart_theta = NULL,
                                model_name = NULL,
                                n_attr_draws = getOption("cv_posterior_draws", 200L),
                                ckpt_dir = NULL) {
  if (is.null(model_name)) model_name <- md$best_model %||% "NLMob_ST_IV"
  fm <- md$fms[[model_name]]
  if (is.null(fm)) return(NULL)
  # Per-fold checkpoint dir; resume completed folds from saved RDS files.
  if (!is.null(ckpt_dir)) dir.create(ckpt_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Exclude structurally-zero geo_ids from holdout when possible; keep them in training.
  # Apply only if the filtered fold set remains valid.
  if ("geo_id" %in% names(md$df)) {
    df_geos    <- unique(as.character(md$df$geo_id))
    total_geos <- length(df_geos)
    eval_geos  <- compute_eval_units(md$df, unit_col = "geo_id", y_col = "Y")
    fold_areas <- unique(as.character(folds_dt$area_id))
    overlap    <- intersect(fold_areas, df_geos)
    if (length(overlap) == 0L) {
      log_msg(sprintf("  [%s] WARNING: folds_dt$area_id and md$df$geo_id share no values; skipping sparse-unit filter",
                      wave_label))
    } else if (length(eval_geos) > 0L && length(eval_geos) < total_geos) {
      cand_folds <- folds_dt[as.character(area_id) %in% eval_geos]
      if (nrow(cand_folds) > 0L && length(unique(cand_folds$cv_fold)) > 0L) {
        folds_dt <- cand_folds
        log_msg(sprintf("  [%s] eval-eligible geo_ids: %d / %d (sparse units kept in training, not scored)",
                        wave_label, length(eval_geos), total_geos))
      } else {
        log_msg(sprintf("  [%s] WARNING: sparse-unit filter would leave 0 folds; skipping filter",
                        wave_label))
      }
    }
  }

  if (nrow(folds_dt) == 0L) {
    log_msg(sprintf("  [%s] ERROR: no folds remain after filter; aborting CV for this wave", wave_label))
    return(NULL)
  }
  n_folds      <- max(folds_dt$cv_fold, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(n_folds) || n_folds < 1L) {
    log_msg(sprintf("  [%s] ERROR: n_folds=%s (non-finite); aborting CV", wave_label, n_folds))
    return(NULL)
  }
  fold_results <- list()
  attr_cells   <- list()   # Per-cell counterfactual attribution results
  attr_pcatm   <- list()   # Per-fold PCAtM attribution summary
  attr_betas   <- list()   # Per-fold mobility coefficient summaries
  attr_inputs  <- list()   # Per-fold attribution inputs for re-aggregation
  fold_diag    <- list()   # Per-fold diagnostics (theta, family, dispersion)
  beta_stab    <- list()   # Per-fold full fixed-effect coefficient summaries
  total_runtime <- 0
  # Sequential warmstart: each successful fold seeds the next.
  current_warm <- warmstart_theta

  for (k in seq_len(n_folds)) {
    held_areas <- folds_dt[cv_fold == k, unique(area_id)]
    if (length(held_areas) == 0) next

    holdout_idx <- which(as.character(md$df$geo_id) %in% held_areas)
    if (length(holdout_idx) == 0) next

    # Resume fold from checkpoint if available.
    ckpt_f <- if (!is.null(ckpt_dir))
      file.path(ckpt_dir, sprintf("fold%03d.rds", k)) else NULL
    if (!is.null(ckpt_f) && file.exists(ckpt_f)) {
      cp <- tryCatch(readRDS(ckpt_f), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(cp) && is.list(cp) && !is.null(cp$fold_result)) {
        fold_results[[k]] <- cp$fold_result
        if (!is.null(cp$attr_cells))  attr_cells[[as.character(k)]]  <- cp$attr_cells
        if (!is.null(cp$attr_pcatm))  attr_pcatm[[as.character(k)]]  <- cp$attr_pcatm
        if (!is.null(cp$attr_betas))  attr_betas[[as.character(k)]]  <- cp$attr_betas
        if (!is.null(cp$attr_inputs)) attr_inputs[[as.character(k)]] <- cp$attr_inputs
        if (!is.null(cp$fold_diag))   fold_diag[[as.character(k)]]   <- cp$fold_diag
        if (!is.null(cp$beta_stab))   beta_stab[[as.character(k)]]   <- cp$beta_stab
        # Adopt resumed theta only when its length matches current warmstart.
        if (!is.null(cp$theta) && is.numeric(cp$theta) &&
            (is.null(current_warm) || length(cp$theta) == length(current_warm))) {
          current_warm <- cp$theta
        }
        if (!is.null(cp$runtime) && is.numeric(cp$runtime))
          total_runtime <- total_runtime + cp$runtime
        log_msg(sprintf("    [%s | %s] fold %d/%d: RESUME ckpt",
                        wave_label, model_name, k, n_folds))
        next
      }
    }

    hf <- fit_holdout(md, fm, holdout_idx,
                      label = sprintf("%s [spatial fold %d/%d] %s", model_name, k, n_folds, wave_label),
                      warmstart_theta = current_warm,
                      model_name = model_name,
                      n_attr_draws = n_attr_draws,
                      # Disable per-fold LCPO to save INLA time; spatial CV uses held-out CRPS/Cov95.
                      compute_cpo = FALSE)
    if (!hf$ok) {
      fold_results[[k]] <- data.table(fold = k, status = "FAILED")
      gc(full = TRUE); next
    }
    total_runtime <- total_runtime + hf$runtime
    if (!is.null(hf$theta) && is.numeric(hf$theta)) current_warm <- hf$theta
    nb_size <- hf$nb_size

    # Out-of-fold mobility attribution outputs.
    if (!is.null(hf$attribution)) {
      a  <- hf$attribution
      ce <- copy(a$cell_attr)
      ce[, `:=`(fold = k,
                geo_id  = as.character(md$df$geo_id[holdout_idx]),
                time_id = md$df$idx_temporal[holdout_idx],
                grid_id = as.character(md$df$grid_id[holdout_idx]))]
      attr_cells[[as.character(k)]] <- ce
      ps <- copy(a$pcatm_summary); ps[, fold := k]
      attr_pcatm[[as.character(k)]] <- ps
      bs <- copy(a$beta_summary);  bs[, fold := k]
      attr_betas[[as.character(k)]] <- bs
      attr_inputs[[as.character(k)]] <- list(
        fold       = k,
        mob_covs   = a$mob_covs,
        X_oof      = a$X_oof,
        beta_draws = a$beta_draws,
        geo_id     = as.character(md$df$geo_id[holdout_idx]),
        time_id    = md$df$idx_temporal[holdout_idx],
        grid_id    = as.character(md$df$grid_id[holdout_idx]))
    }

    # Per-fold diagnostics and beta stability.
    fd_row <- data.table(fold = k,
                         runtime_min = round(hf$runtime, 1),
                         n_oof = length(holdout_idx),
                         n_areas = length(held_areas),
                         nb_size = nb_size %||% NA_real_,
                         family = hf$family %||% NA_character_,
                         pred_disp = { mu_v <- hf$mu[is.finite(hf$mu)]
                                       if (length(mu_v) > 1)
                                         var(mu_v) / max(mean(mu_v), 1e-12)
                                       else NA_real_ })
    if (!is.null(hf$theta) && is.numeric(hf$theta)) {
      th <- as.list(hf$theta); names(th) <- paste0("theta_", seq_along(hf$theta))
      fd_row <- cbind(fd_row, as.data.table(th))
    }
    fold_diag[[as.character(k)]] <- fd_row
    if (!is.null(hf$fixed_full)) {
      ff <- as.data.table(hf$fixed_full, keep.rownames = "covariate")
      ff[, fold := k]
      beta_stab[[as.character(k)]] <- ff
    }

    # Outlier flag for scoring only; training is unchanged.
    OUT_Q <- getOption("cv_outlier_q", 0.999)
    mu_safe <- pmax(hf$mu, 1e-6)
    if (!is.null(nb_size) && is.finite(nb_size) && nb_size > 0) {
      q_hi <- qnbinom(OUT_Q, size = nb_size, mu = mu_safe)
    } else {
      q_hi <- qpois(OUT_Q, lambda = mu_safe)
    }
    is_outlier <- !is.na(hf$y_true) & hf$y_true > q_hi
    pct_out <- if (length(hf$y_true) > 0) mean(is_outlier, na.rm = TRUE) else 0

    fam <- hf$family %||% "auto"
    cs_all  <- cv_scores(hf$y_true, hf$mu, hf$sd_fit, nb_size = nb_size, family = fam)
    cs_all[, `:=`(fold = k, n_areas = length(held_areas),
                  runtime = round(hf$runtime, 1), status = "OK",
                  outlier_mode = "all", pct_outlier = pct_out)]
    keep <- !is_outlier
    cs_trim <- cv_scores(hf$y_true[keep], hf$mu[keep], hf$sd_fit[keep],
                         nb_size = nb_size, family = fam)
    cs_trim[, `:=`(fold = k, n_areas = length(held_areas),
                   runtime = round(hf$runtime, 1), status = "OK",
                   outlier_mode = sprintf("trimmed_q%03d", round(1000 * OUT_Q)),
                   pct_outlier = pct_out)]
    cell_scores <- rbind(cs_all, cs_trim, fill = TRUE)

    ho_dt <- data.table(
      geo_id = as.character(md$df$geo_id[holdout_idx]),
      time_id = hf$time_id,
      y_true = hf$y_true, mu = hf$mu, sd_fit = hf$sd_fit,
      pred_var = nb_pred_var(hf$mu, hf$sd_fit, nb_size))

    area_scores_dt <- ho_dt[, .(obs = sum(y_true, na.rm = TRUE),
                                pred = sum(mu, na.rm = TRUE),
                                sd = sqrt(sum(pred_var, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                n_cells = .N, n_days = uniqueN(time_id)),
                            by = geo_id]
    area_scores_dt[, `:=`(fold = k,
                          lo = pmax(pred - 1.96 * sd, 0),
                          hi = pred + 1.96 * sd,
                          covered = (obs >= pmax(pred - 1.96 * sd, 0)) &
                                    (obs <= pred + 1.96 * sd),
                          abs_err = abs(obs - pred),
                          pct_err = abs(obs - pred) / pmax(obs, 1) * 100)]

    area_summary <- cv_scores_area(area_scores_dt)
    area_summary[, `:=`(fold = k, runtime = round(hf$runtime, 1))]

    pred_dt <- ho_dt[, .(geo_id, time_id, y_true, mu, sd_fit, pred_var)]
    pred_dt[, fold := k]

    # Legacy out-of-fold PCAtM row for existing readers.
    fe_train      <- hf$fixed
    mob_covs_fold <- grep("^(mob_lag|exposure_import)", rownames(fe_train), value = TRUE)
    pcatm_fold    <- NULL
    if (length(mob_covs_fold) > 0) {
      x_oof <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(md$df)[holdout_idx, mob_covs_fold, drop = FALSE])
      x_oof[is.na(x_oof)] <- 0
      bm <- fe_train[mob_covs_fold, "mean"]
      bs <- fe_train[mob_covs_fold, "sd"]
      eta_mob     <- as.numeric(x_oof %*% bm)
      eta_mob_var <- as.numeric((x_oof^2) %*% (bs^2))
      # UT_w3 fix: winsorise per-cell eta at the 1%/99% quantiles before exp-link averaging.
      qlo_eta <- as.numeric(quantile(eta_mob, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE))
      qhi_eta <- as.numeric(quantile(eta_mob, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
      eta_mob_w99   <- pmin(pmax(eta_mob, qlo_eta), qhi_eta)
      # Clip eta to [-2,2] and flag degenerate mobility covariates.
      eta_mob_clip2 <- pmin(pmax(eta_mob, -2), 2)
      col_vars_oof  <- apply(x_oof, 2L, stats::var, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_degen_cols  <- sum(col_vars_oof < 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE)
      degen_frac    <- n_degen_cols / max(ncol(x_oof), 1L)
      pcatm_fold  <- data.table(
        fold              = k,
        n_oof             = length(holdout_idx),
        n_mob_covs        = length(mob_covs_fold),
        AMLP_oof          = mean(eta_mob),
        AMLP_oof_sd       = sqrt(mean(eta_mob_var)),
        pcatm_oof         = 1 - exp(-mean(eta_mob)),
        AMLP_oof_w99      = mean(eta_mob_w99),
        pcatm_oof_w99     = 1 - exp(-mean(eta_mob_w99)),
        AMLP_oof_clip2    = mean(eta_mob_clip2),
        pcatm_oof_clip2   = 1 - exp(-mean(eta_mob_clip2)),
        eta_extreme_frac  = mean(abs(eta_mob) > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_degen_cols      = n_degen_cols,
        degen_frac        = degen_frac,
        is_degenerate     = degen_frac > 0.50,
        pct_pos           = 100 * mean(eta_mob > 0))
    }

    fold_results[[k]] <- list(cell_scores = cell_scores,
                              area_scores = area_summary,
                              area_detail = area_scores_dt,
                              predictions = pred_dt,
                              pcatm_oof   = pcatm_fold)

    # ── ckpt save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!is.null(ckpt_f)) {
      tryCatch(
        saveRDS(list(
          fold_result = fold_results[[k]],
          attr_cells  = attr_cells[[as.character(k)]],
          attr_pcatm  = attr_pcatm[[as.character(k)]],
          attr_betas  = attr_betas[[as.character(k)]],
          attr_inputs = attr_inputs[[as.character(k)]],
          fold_diag   = fold_diag[[as.character(k)]],
          beta_stab   = beta_stab[[as.character(k)]],
          theta       = current_warm,
          runtime     = hf$runtime),
          ckpt_f),
        error = function(e) log_msg(sprintf("    [%s | %s] fold %d/%d: ckpt save FAILED: %s",
                                            wave_label, model_name, k, n_folds, conditionMessage(e))))
    }
    rm(hf, ho_dt); gc(full = TRUE)
  }

  valid <- Filter(is.list, fold_results)
  if (length(valid) == 0) return(NULL)

  cell_all <- rbindlist(lapply(valid, `[[`, "cell_scores"), fill = TRUE)
  area_all <- rbindlist(lapply(valid, `[[`, "area_scores"), fill = TRUE)
  detail_all <- rbindlist(lapply(valid, `[[`, "area_detail"), fill = TRUE)
  pred_all <- rbindlist(lapply(valid, `[[`, "predictions"), fill = TRUE)
  pcatm_oof_all <- rbindlist(lapply(valid, `[[`, "pcatm_oof"), fill = TRUE)

  # Per-mode cell aggregator (rows: "all" and trimmed_q999).
  score_cols <- intersect(c("RMSE","MAE","R2","CRPS","Cov50","Cov80","Cov95",
                            "Cov95_gauss","logS","DSS","cal_intercept",
                            "cal_slope","pit_W1"), names(cell_all))
  if ("outlier_mode" %in% names(cell_all)) {
    cell_avg_by_mode <- cell_all[, c(list(
        N = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE), n_folds = .N,
        pct_outlier = mean(pct_outlier, na.rm = TRUE),
        runtime = round(total_runtime, 1)),
        lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE)),
      by = outlier_mode, .SDcols = score_cols]
    cell_avg <- cell_avg_by_mode[outlier_mode == "all"][, outlier_mode := NULL][1]
  } else {
    cell_avg_by_mode <- NULL
    cell_avg <- data.table(
      RMSE  = mean(cell_all$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
      MAE   = mean(cell_all$MAE,  na.rm = TRUE),
      R2    = mean(cell_all$R2,   na.rm = TRUE),
      CRPS  = mean(cell_all$CRPS, na.rm = TRUE),
      Cov95 = mean(cell_all$Cov95, na.rm = TRUE),
      N = sum(cell_all$N, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_folds = length(valid), runtime = round(total_runtime, 1))
  }

  area_avg <- data.table(
    area_R2 = mean(area_all$R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_RMSE = mean(area_all$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_MAE = mean(area_all$MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_MdAPE = median(detail_all$pct_err, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_Cov95 = mean(detail_all$covered, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_Corr = cor(detail_all$obs, detail_all$pred))

  # Per-area cell-day scores by held-out fold using the fold-specific family.
  per_area_scores <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred_all) && nrow(pred_all) > 0 && length(fold_diag) > 0) {
    fd_dt <- rbindlist(fold_diag, fill = TRUE)
    fam_lkp <- fd_dt[, .(fold, nb_size, family)]
    pa <- merge(pred_all, fam_lkp, by = "fold", all.x = TRUE)
    per_area_scores <- pa[, {
      nb <- nb_size[1]; fm_i <- family[1] %||% "auto"
      sc <- cv_scores(y_true, mu, sd_fit,
                      nb_size = if (!is.null(nb) && is.finite(nb)) nb else NULL,
                      family  = if (is.na(fm_i)) "auto" else fm_i)
      c(list(fold = fold[1], n_cell_days = .N,
             n_days = uniqueN(time_id)), as.list(sc))
    }, by = geo_id]
    setcolorder(per_area_scores, c("geo_id", "fold", "n_cell_days", "n_days"))
  }

  list(cell_avg = cell_avg, cell_avg_by_mode = cell_avg_by_mode,
       area_avg = area_avg,
       cell_folds = cell_all, area_folds = area_all,
       area_detail = detail_all, predictions = pred_all,
       per_area_scores = per_area_scores,
       pcatm_oof = pcatm_oof_all,
       # Attribution and diagnostics.
       attr_cells  = if (length(attr_cells) > 0) rbindlist(attr_cells, fill=TRUE) else NULL,
       attr_pcatm  = if (length(attr_pcatm) > 0) rbindlist(attr_pcatm, fill=TRUE) else NULL,
       attr_betas  = if (length(attr_betas) > 0) rbindlist(attr_betas, fill=TRUE) else NULL,
       attr_inputs = attr_inputs,
       fold_diag   = if (length(fold_diag)  > 0) rbindlist(fold_diag,  fill=TRUE) else NULL,
       beta_stability = if (length(beta_stab) > 0) rbindlist(beta_stab, fill=TRUE) else NULL)
}
```

## Wave Selection

```{r wave_selection}
ALL_WAVES <- c("NY_wave1", "NY_wave2", "NY_wave3", "UT_wave1", "UT_wave2", "UT_wave3")

run_waves <- if (params$run_waves == "all") {
  ALL_WAVES
} else if (params$run_waves %in% c("NY", "UT")) {
  ALL_WAVES[grepl(params$run_waves, ALL_WAVES)]
} else if (params$run_waves %in% ALL_WAVES) {
  params$run_waves
} else {
  ALL_WAVES
}
```

## Main Pipeline

```{r pipeline}
all_spatial <- list()

for (w in run_waves) {
  wv <- load_wave_for_cv(w)
  md <- wv$md; out_dir <- wv$out_dir
  cv_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "validation")
  dir.create(cv_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # ── Best model: hard-coded per wave in BEST_MODEL_BY_WAVE (helpers/_cv_helpers.R)
  best_mn   <- wv$best_model
  best_waic <- wv$model_results$best_model
  log_msg(sprintf("[%s] using best model: %s (WAIC-best on file: %s)",
                  w, best_mn, ifelse(is.null(best_waic), "NA", best_waic)))
  if (!is.null(best_waic) && best_waic != best_mn)
    log_msg(sprintf("[%s] WARNING: hard-coded best (%s) differs from on-disk best (%s)",
                    w, best_mn, best_waic))

  # Warmstart from full posterior mode saved by 09_fit_model for the best model.
  ws_theta <- NULL
  ws_file  <- file.path(out_dir, "tables", "ckpt", paste0(best_mn, "_mode.rds"))
  if (file.exists(ws_file)) {
    ws_obj <- tryCatch(readRDS(ws_file), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.numeric(ws_obj) && length(ws_obj) > 0) ws_theta <- ws_obj
    else if (!is.null(ws_obj$theta)) ws_theta <- ws_obj$theta
    if (!is.null(ws_theta)) log_msg("    [warmstart] loaded \u03b8 (",
                                    length(ws_theta), " hyperparameters) for ", w)
  }

  fld <- create_area_folds(md$df, md$grid_sf, wv$state)
  ckpt_dir_w <- file.path(cv_out_dir, "by_model", best_mn, "ckpt_folds")
  scv <- run_area_spatial_cv(md, fld$fold_dt, w, warmstart_theta = ws_theta,
                             model_name = best_mn,
                             ckpt_dir = ckpt_dir_w)

  if (!is.null(scv)) {
    scv$state <- wv$state
    scv$wave  <- w
    scv$folds <- fld$fold_dt
  }

  all_spatial[[w]] <- scv
  rm(md, wv); gc(full = TRUE)
}
```

## Results

### Cell-Level Scores by Fold

```{r cell_results, results='asis'}
cell_rows <- rbindlist(lapply(names(all_spatial), function(nm) {
  rv <- all_spatial[[nm]]
  if (is.null(rv)) return(NULL)
  s <- copy(rv$cell_avg)
  s[, wave := nm]; s
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(cell_rows) > 0) {
  print(kable(cell_rows[, .(wave, RMSE = round(RMSE, 3), MAE = round(MAE, 3),
                             R2 = round(R2, 3), CRPS = round(CRPS, 4),
                             Cov95 = round(Cov95, 3), n_folds, runtime)],
              format = "pipe",
              caption = "Spatial CV -- Cell-level average scores across folds"))
}
```

### Area-Level Scores

```{r area_results, results='asis'}
area_rows <- rbindlist(lapply(names(all_spatial), function(nm) {
  rv <- all_spatial[[nm]]
  if (is.null(rv)) return(NULL)
  s <- copy(rv$area_avg)
  s[, wave := nm]; s
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(area_rows) > 0) {
  print(kable(area_rows[, .(wave, R2 = round(area_R2, 3),
                             RMSE = round(area_RMSE, 1),
                             MAE = round(area_MAE, 1),
                             MdAPE = round(area_MdAPE, 1),
                             Cov95 = round(area_Cov95, 3),
                             Corr = round(area_Corr, 3))],
              format = "pipe",
              caption = "Spatial CV -- Area-level aggregate scores"))
}
```

### Area Scatter Plots

```{r area_scatter, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
wave_labels <- c(NY_wave1 = "Wave 1: Mar-May 2020",
                 NY_wave2 = "Wave 2: Dec 2020-Feb 2021",
                 NY_wave3 = "Wave 3: Dec 2021-Feb 2022",
                 UT_wave1 = "Wave 1", UT_wave2 = "Wave 2", UT_wave3 = "Wave 3")

scatter_panels <- list()
for (nm in names(all_spatial)) {
  rv <- all_spatial[[nm]]
  if (is.null(rv)) next

  area_dt <- rv$area_detail
  lbl <- ifelse(!is.null(wave_labels[nm]), wave_labels[nm], nm)
  r2 <- round(rv$area_avg$area_R2, 3)
  cov <- round(rv$area_avg$area_Cov95 * 100, 1)

  scatter_panels[[nm]] <- ggplot(area_dt, aes(obs, pred)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2, width = 0, colour = "steelblue") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s | R²=%.3f | Cov95=%.1f%%", lbl, r2, cov),
         x = "Observed total cases", y = "Predicted total cases") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
}

if (length(scatter_panels) > 0) {
  p <- wrap_plots(scatter_panels, ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Spatial CV -- Observed vs Predicted Area Totals",
      subtitle = "MODZCTA (NYC) / County LOCO (Utah) | red line = OLS fit | grey dashed = 1:1",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
                    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40")))
  print(p)
}
```

### Comparison with Temporal CV

```{r comparison, results='asis'}
fig_dir <- file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, "figures")
tcv_file <- file.path(fig_dir, "cv_temporal_summary_all.csv")

if (file.exists(tcv_file) && nrow(cell_rows) > 0) {
  tcv_summary <- fread(tcv_file)
  tcv_h3 <- tcv_summary[horizon == 3, .(wave, RMSE_temporal = RMSE, R2_temporal = R2,
                                          CRPS_temporal = CRPS, Cov95_temporal = Cov95)]

  spatial_summary <- cell_rows[, .(wave, RMSE_spatial = RMSE, R2_spatial = R2,
                                    CRPS_spatial = CRPS, Cov95_spatial = Cov95)]

  merged <- merge(spatial_summary, tcv_h3, by = "wave", all = TRUE)
  merged[, `:=`(RMSE_spatial = round(RMSE_spatial, 3), RMSE_temporal = round(RMSE_temporal, 3),
                R2_spatial = round(R2_spatial, 3), R2_temporal = round(R2_temporal, 3),
                CRPS_spatial = round(CRPS_spatial, 4), CRPS_temporal = round(CRPS_temporal, 4),
                Cov95_spatial = round(Cov95_spatial, 3), Cov95_temporal = round(Cov95_temporal, 3))]

  print(kable(merged, format = "pipe",
              caption = "Spatial vs Temporal CV (h=3) -- Cell-level Score Comparison"))
}
```

## Save Results

```{r save}
fig_dir <- file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (nm in names(all_spatial)) {
  rv <- all_spatial[[nm]]
  if (is.null(rv)) next

  cv_out_dir <- file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, nm, "validation")
  dir.create(cv_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  saveRDS(rv, file.path(cv_out_dir, "spatial_cv_area_results.rds"))
  fwrite(rv$cell_folds, file.path(cv_out_dir, "spatial_cv_area_cell_scores.csv"))
  fwrite(rv$area_folds, file.path(cv_out_dir, "spatial_cv_area_scores.csv"))
  fwrite(rv$area_detail, file.path(cv_out_dir, "spatial_cv_area_detail.csv"))
  fwrite(rv$predictions, file.path(cv_out_dir, "spatial_cv_area_predictions.csv"))
  if (!is.null(rv$per_area_scores) && nrow(rv$per_area_scores) > 0) {
    fwrite(rv$per_area_scores,
           file.path(cv_out_dir, "spatial_cv_per_area_scores.csv"))
  }
  if (!is.null(rv$pcatm_oof) && nrow(rv$pcatm_oof) > 0) {
    fwrite(rv$pcatm_oof, file.path(cv_out_dir, "pcatm_oof.csv"))
  }
  # Attribution and diagnostic outputs.
  if (!is.null(rv$attr_cells)  && nrow(rv$attr_cells)  > 0)
    fwrite(rv$attr_cells,  file.path(cv_out_dir, "attribution_cell_long.csv"))
  if (!is.null(rv$attr_pcatm)  && nrow(rv$attr_pcatm)  > 0)
    fwrite(rv$attr_pcatm,  file.path(cv_out_dir, "attribution_pcatm.csv"))
  if (!is.null(rv$attr_betas)  && nrow(rv$attr_betas)  > 0)
    fwrite(rv$attr_betas,  file.path(cv_out_dir, "attribution_beta_summary.csv"))
  if (!is.null(rv$attr_inputs) && length(rv$attr_inputs) > 0)
    saveRDS(rv$attr_inputs, file.path(cv_out_dir, "attribution_inputs.rds"))
  if (!is.null(rv$fold_diag)   && nrow(rv$fold_diag)   > 0)
    fwrite(rv$fold_diag,   file.path(cv_out_dir, "fold_diagnostics.csv"))
  if (!is.null(rv$beta_stability) && nrow(rv$beta_stability) > 0)
    fwrite(rv$beta_stability, file.path(cv_out_dir, "beta_stability.csv"))
}

if (nrow(cell_rows) > 0) fwrite(cell_rows, file.path(fig_dir, "cv_spatial_summary_all.csv"))

if (length(scatter_panels) > 0) {
  p_scatter <- wrap_plots(scatter_panels, ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Spatial CV -- Observed vs Predicted Area Totals (per-wave best model)",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14)))
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cv_spatial_scatter_all.png"), p_scatter,
         width = 14, height = ceiling(length(scatter_panels) / 3) * 5, dpi = 150)
  tryCatch({
    tex_fig_dir <- file.path("thesis_latex", "figures")
    dir.create(tex_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggsave(file.path(tex_fig_dir, "spatial_cv_scatter.png"), p_scatter,
           width = 14, height = ceiling(length(scatter_panels) / 3) * 5, dpi = 300)
  }, error = function(e) message("thesis_latex copy skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)))
}
```
